{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check all unique values in customer_segment
unique_segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check for case sensitivity or typos
lowercase_segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].str.lower().unique()

# Look for 'loyal' in any form
contains_loyal = sales_df['customer_segment'].str.contains('loyal', case=False, na=False)

unique_segments, lowercase_segments, contains_loyal.sum()"}
